overview_description: Create, read, update and delete workflows, and read their stages, milestones and component instance history.
intro: Workflows define the stages and milestones a record moves through. Use these endpoints to create and change workflows and to read their stages, milestones and the workflow history of custom component instances. This area has 15 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
warning: **Creating a workflow currently fails.** `POST /workflows` returns `500` and creates nothing, so updating and deleting a workflow have not been confirmed either.
notes: **Creates and updates are wrapped in `workflow`.** One workflow comes back under `workflow` too, and `name` is required to create one.
**A new workflow starts as a draft.** An update can move a draft to active, and move an active workflow to inactive and back.
**A workflow is read by its `wf_` id or its `code`.** The milestone listing takes the `wf_` id in its `workflow_uuid` slot.

**Component instance routes take the component's dashed uuid.** Under `/workflows/custom_components`, `component_uuid` is the hex of the `cmp_` id with the dashes put back and `object_code` is the instance's `code`; the `cmp_` id and the bare hex return `404`.
**Deleting a milestone sits in this area.** `DELETE /milestones/{milestone_uuid}` is listed with the workflow endpoints.
**Listings page by cursor.** Records sit under `data`; pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` to read the next page, and stop when `pagination.has_more` is `false`.

endpoints.title: List workflows
endpoints.summary: Lists the workflows on your instance, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns a page of workflows under `data`, with cursor `pagination`. A deleted workflow is not listed. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, such as `filter_created_on_gte`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a workflow
endpoints.summary: Retrieves one workflow by its `wf_` id or its `code`.
endpoints.description: Returns the workflow under `workflow`. A deleted workflow returns `404`.

parameters.name: workflow_id
parameters.description: The workflow's `wf_` id, or its `code`.

404.description: No workflow has that id or code, or the workflow is deleted.

endpoints.title: Create a workflow
endpoints.summary: Creates a workflow as a draft and returns it.
endpoints.description: Send the workflow wrapped in `workflow`. `name` is required. Unknown keys are refused. The new workflow starts with the status `draft` and comes back under `workflow`.

entity.description: The entity the workflow belongs to, such as `account`.

workflow.description: The new workflow. Keys the API does not read are refused.

500.description: Currently returned for every request; no workflow is created.

endpoints.warning: **This call currently returns `500`.** No workflow is created.

endpoints.title: Update a workflow
endpoints.summary: Changes a workflow's fields or moves its status, and returns the workflow.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change wrapped in `workflow`. A draft can move to active, and an active workflow can move to inactive and back. The updated workflow comes back under `workflow`.

parameters.name: workflow_id
parameters.description: The workflow's `wf_` id.

display_name.description: The name shown for the workflow.

status.description: The status to move to. A draft can become active, and active and inactive can switch.

endpoints.warning: **This call has not been confirmed.** It needs a workflow made by the create, which currently returns `500`.

endpoints.title: Delete a workflow
endpoints.summary: Deletes a workflow. Nothing comes back.
endpoints.description: Returns `204` with no body. The workflow is marked deleted, is no longer listed, and a read of it returns `404`. A pre-built workflow cannot be deleted.

parameters.name: workflow_id
parameters.description: The workflow's `wf_` id.

endpoints.warning: **This call has not been confirmed.** It needs a workflow made by the create, which currently returns `500`.

endpoints.title: List a workflow's stages
endpoints.summary: Lists the stages of one workflow, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns a page of the workflow's stages under `data`, with cursor `pagination`. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, such as `filter_created_on_gte`.

parameters.name: workflow_id
parameters.description: The workflow's `wf_` id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: A page of the workflow's stages.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a workflow stage
endpoints.summary: Retrieves one stage of a workflow by its `wfs_` id.
endpoints.description: Returns the stage under `workflow_stage`. A stage id the workflow does not hold returns `404` with the code `resource_not_found`.

parameters.name: workflow_id
parameters.description: The workflow's `wf_` id.

parameters.name: stage_id
parameters.description: The stage's `wfs_` id.

endpoints.title: List a workflow's milestones
endpoints.summary: Lists the milestones defined on one workflow, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns a page of the workflow's milestones under `data`, with cursor `pagination`. The `workflow_uuid` slot takes the workflow's `wf_` id. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, such as `filter_created_on_gte`.

parameters.name: workflow_uuid
parameters.description: The workflow's `wf_` id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: A page of the workflow's milestones.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a workflow milestone
endpoints.summary: Retrieves one milestone defined on a workflow, by its `wfm_` id.
endpoints.description: Returns the milestone under `workflow_milestone`, with the same fields a listed milestone carries.

parameters.name: workflow_id
parameters.description: The workflow's `wf_` id.

parameters.name: milestone_id
parameters.description: The milestone's `wfm_` id.

endpoints.title: Delete a milestone
endpoints.summary: Deletes one milestone. Nothing comes back.
endpoints.description: Returns `204` with no body. A milestone id that does not exist returns `404` with the code `resource_not_found`.

parameters.name: milestone_uuid
parameters.description: The milestone's id, as a milestones listing shows it.

endpoints.title: List a component instance's workflow history
endpoints.summary: Lists the workflow history of one custom component instance, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Identify the component by its dashed uuid and the instance by its `code`. Returns a page of history entries under `data`, with cursor `pagination`. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, such as `filter_created_on_gte`.

parameters.name: component_uuid
parameters.description: The component's dashed uuid: the hex of its `cmp_` id with the dashes put back. The `cmp_` id itself returns `404`.

parameters.name: object_code
parameters.description: The component instance's `code`, not its `cco_` id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: A page of the instance's workflow history.

404.description: The component is given by its `cmp_` id or its bare hex rather than its dashed uuid.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a component instance's milestone
endpoints.summary: Retrieves one workflow milestone of a custom component instance, by its `wfmi_` id.
endpoints.description: Identify the component by its dashed uuid and the instance by its `code`. Returns the milestone under `workflow_milestone_instance`. A milestone id that does not exist returns `404` with the code `resource_not_found`.

parameters.name: component_uuid
parameters.description: The component's dashed uuid: the hex of its `cmp_` id with the dashes put back. The `cmp_` id itself returns `404`.

parameters.name: object_code
parameters.description: The component instance's `code`, not its `cco_` id.

404.description: No milestone has that id, or the component is given by its `cmp_` id or bare hex rather than its dashed uuid.

endpoints.title: List a component instance's workflow history by instance code
endpoints.summary: Lists the workflow history of one custom component instance, named by its code alone.
endpoints.description: Unlike `/workflows/custom_components/...`, this route takes only the instance's `code` and returns its records under `histories`, not `data`, with `pagination` beside them.

parameters.name: component_object_id
parameters.description: The component instance's `code`.

200.description: The instance's workflow history, under `histories`, with `pagination`.

endpoints.title: List a component instance's milestones by settings uuid

endpoints.description: Unlike `/workflows/custom_components/...`, this route takes the component's `uuid` as the component settings listing shows it, and returns its records under `milestones`, not `data`, with `pagination` beside them.

parameters.name: component_uuid
parameters.description: The component's `uuid`, as the component settings listing shows it.

parameters.name: component_object_id
parameters.description: The component instance's `code`.
